mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and increased discount rates, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL YoY > 5% does not correlate with tighter monetary policy.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3% signals a tightening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or UNRATE < 3% does not correlate with increased corporate earnings.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over a 3-month period signals increased economic activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of instances, or HOUST increase does not correlate with increased economic activity.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% MoM signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO decline does not correlate with supply contraction.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow faster than GDP (GDPC1) over a quarter, it signals strong consumer demand, which positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or RSAFS growth does not outpace GDPC1.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increases by more than 50 basis points in a month, it signals a tightening monetary policy, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or FEDFUNDS increase does not correlate with tighter monetary policy.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals strong job growth, which boosts consumer spending and positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or PAYEMS increase does not correlate with increased consumer spending.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in housing starts (HOUST) exceeds the year-over-year change in GDP (GDPC1), it signals a disproportionate increase in demand for housing, which positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or HOUST YoY growth does not outpace GDPC1 YoY.
